arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a CONTROLLED INTERMEDIATE STRUCTURE EDIT, not a redesign. Image 1 has three figures. Extract and upscale ONLY the MIDDLE SIDE-ORIENTED FIGURE into one clean complete single mecha portrait on ivory. Preserve the middle figure's exact pose, proportions, silhouette, head, mane length/placement, chest nose depth, shoulder housing slope and height, white core shoulder cap, arm position, fists, hips, thighs, drill mounting, lower-leg contours and feet. Do not blend in either front or rear figure and do not reproduce the sheet. Make ONLY ONE mechanical change to that extracted middle figure: correct the engine direction. In Image 1 its large circular fan incorrectly faces the side viewer. Image 2 shows the desired ENGINE AXIS ONLY: cylindrical engine length runs in the robot's FRONT-BACK direction, intake pointing toward image LEFT (same direction as face and cockpit nose), exhaust toward image RIGHT. Replace only the wrong outward fan with that fore-aft cylindrical engine beneath the EXISTING selected triangular shoulder housing, showing the side of the cylinder and a narrow front intake rim. DO NOT take Image 2's flat wing strip or torso/arm shape. KEEP THE WHOLE SLOPING TRIANGULAR SHOULDER/WING SHAPE FROM IMAGE 1'S MIDDLE FIGURE, INCLUDING ITS RESTRAINED HEIGHT RELATIVE TO THE HEAD. No upward enlargement, no giant shoulder crest, no new vertical fins, no new tracks, no new armor details, no stretching legs, no fist enlargement yet. This step must preserve all body geometry except the engine. Clean linework and cel colors, no new painterly rendering. Fully inside frame. No text, no labels, no arrows, no green marks, no extra figure. A faithful isolated existing side drawing with one engine-axis repair.
